# Conditional Resource-Pack Assets

Read this reference only when the requested pack uses current or legacy item
models, sounds, fonts, OptiFine, or shaders. Keep each feature within the target
client's supported format.

## Current and legacy item models

For **1.21.4 and later**, place item definitions in
`assets/<namespace>/items/<item>.json`. The `minecraft:custom_model_data`
string property reads the component's `strings` list. A `when` value can be one
string or a non-empty list of strings; numeric values such as `1001` are not
valid for this selector.

```json
{
  "model": {
    "type": "minecraft:select",
    "property": "minecraft:custom_model_data",
    "fallback": {
      "type": "minecraft:model",
      "model": "minecraft:item/stick"
    },
    "cases": [
      {
        "when": ["magic_wand"],
        "model": {
          "type": "minecraft:model",
          "model": "mypack:item/magic_wand"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Give the matching item component with a string value:

```mcfunction
/give @s minecraft:stick[custom_model_data={strings:["magic_wand"]}]
```

For **1.21.3 and earlier**, use a model's legacy `overrides` array and numeric
`predicate.custom_model_data` values. Do not mix the legacy override format into
the current `items/` definition.

```json
{
  "parent": "minecraft:item/handheld",
  "textures": { "layer0": "minecraft:item/stick" },
  "overrides": [
    {
      "predicate": { "custom_model_data": 1001 },
      "model": "mypack:item/magic_wand"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Sounds

The namespace of an event is the namespace containing its `sounds.json`. The
namespace in a sound entry's `name` identifies the sound-file namespace. Put a
custom event in `assets/mypack/sounds.json` and its file at
`assets/mypack/sounds/ui/click.ogg`.

```json
{
  "ui.click": {
    "sounds": [
      { "name": "mypack:ui/click", "volume": 1.0 }
    ]
  },
  "ui.click_alias": {
    "sounds": [
      { "name": "mypack:ui.click", "type": "event" }
    ]
  }
}
```

An omitted `type` is a sound-file entry and resolves to an `.ogg` file. An
`event` entry references another sound event and must never be treated as a file
path. `sounds.json` maps events to sound objects; it does not choose the sound
source. A command chooses its source, for example
`/playsound mypack:ui.click ui @s` (the `ui` source is available from 1.21.6),
and mod code supplies the relevant `SoundSource`. Use `replace: true` only when
intentionally replacing an event inherited from a lower-priority pack.

## Fonts

Place font definitions at `assets/<namespace>/font/<name>.json`. A bitmap
provider's `file` is a texture resource location including `.png`.

```json
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "type": "bitmap",
      "file": "mypack:font/icons.png",
      "ascent": 8,
      "height": 9,
      "chars": ["\uE000", "\uE001"]
    }
  ]
}
```

Use private-use characters deliberately and keep each bitmap cell consistent
with its declared height.

## Client-mod and shader boundaries

OptiFine CIT files under `assets/minecraft/optifine/` are OptiFine-specific and
do not work in vanilla or Iris. Do not present them as a portable item system.

Iris shader packs are separate ZIPs with a top-level `shaders/` directory. They
are selected through Iris, not loaded as `assets/iris/shaders` inside a resource
pack. Vanilla resource packs do not provide a supported way to override core
render shaders. Keep shader packs separate from a vanilla resource-pack
deliverable, and test them with the exact Iris version named by the user.

## Sources

- [Mojang: Java Edition 1.21.4 item models](https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/article/minecraft-java-edition-1-21-4)
- [NeoForge 1.21.8 sounds](https://docs.neoforged.net/docs/1.21.8/resources/client/sounds/)
- [Iris documentation](https://irisshaders.dev/)
### Random texture (weighted variants)
```json
{
  "variants": {
    "": [
      { "model": "minecraft:block/grass_block",  "weight": 3 },
      { "model": "minecraft:block/grass_block_2" }
    ]
  }
}
```
### Multipart (slabs, fences, walls)
```json
{
  "multipart": [
    { "apply": { "model": "mypack:block/my_slab_bottom" }, "when": { "type": "bottom" } },
    { "apply": { "model": "mypack:block/my_slab_top"    }, "when": { "type": "top"    } },
    { "apply": { "model": "mypack:block/my_block"        }, "when": { "type": "double" } }
  ]
}
```
---
## Textures
- Format: **PNG**, RGBA (32-bit)
- Standard block/item size: **16×16 px**
- Textures can be larger (32×32, 64×64) — Minecraft scales them, but stick to powers of 2
- Animation requires height = N × width (e.g., 16×64 for 4 frames)
- Place block textures in `assets/<namespace>/textures/block/`
- Place item textures in `assets/<namespace>/textures/item/`
- All textures are referenced without the `.png` extension in JSON
### Animated texture MCMETA
`assets/minecraft/textures/block/fire_0.png.mcmeta`:
```json
{
  "animation": {
    "frametime": 2,
    "frames": [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7]
  }
}
```
If `frames` is omitted, all frames play sequentially. `frametime` is in game ticks (default 1).
### GUI sprites (1.20.2+)
Place sprites at `assets/minecraft/textures/gui/sprites/<category>/<name>.png`.
Reference them with `<category>/<name>` in code/JSON.
### 26.1 block-model texture entries
For 26.1, a block-model `textures` entry may remain a sprite string or use an
object. The object must have a string `sprite`; `force_translucent`, when set,
must be a boolean.
```json
{
  "textures": {
    "all": {
      "sprite": "mypack:block/frosted_panel",
      "force_translucent": true
    }
  }
}
```
Both forms identify a sprite without `.png`. Use `force_translucent` only when
the geometry must render in the translucent pass despite its sprite pixels.
---
## Sounds
An event's namespace comes from the namespace containing `sounds.json`; a
sound entry's `name` identifies the sound-file namespace. Sound files are Vorbis
`.ogg` under `assets/<namespace>/sounds/`. Read
[conditional assets](references/conditional-assets.md) for a correct event
example, aliases, sound-source selection, and replacement behavior.
---
## Language Files
`assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json`:
```json
{
  "block.mypack.my_block": "My Custom Block",
  "item.mypack.my_item": "Magic Wand",
  "entity.mypack.my_mob": "Forest Guardian",
  "death.attack.mypack.laser": "%1$s was zapped by %2$s"
}
```
- Use the exact translation key format for your mod/datapack namespace
- File name is the locale code (e.g., `fr_fr.json`, `de_de.json`)
- Always provide `en_us.json` as the primary fallback
---
## Fonts
Read [conditional assets](references/conditional-assets.md) for bitmap provider
layout and private-use icon guidance.
---
## OptiFine and shaders
OptiFine CIT and Iris shader packs have client-mod-specific formats. Read
[conditional assets](references/conditional-assets.md) before adding either;
they are not portable vanilla resource-pack features.
---
## Installation
```bash
# Singleplayer: place in
~/.minecraft/resourcepacks/my-pack/
# or
~/.minecraft/resourcepacks/my-pack.zip
# Server-side (forces on clients):
# Set in server.properties:
resource-pack=https://example.com/my-pack.zip
resource-pack-sha1=<sha1 hash>
resource-pack-prompt={"text":"Required pack","color":"gold"}
```

| Problem | Cause | Fix |
|---------|-------|-----|
| Model not showing | Wrong JSON path or syntax error | Check `assets/<namespace>/models/` path; validate JSON |
| Black/pink checkerboard | Texture path wrong or missing | Check `textures/` path, file extension not in JSON |

# Minecraft World Generation
Use this skill for biome, dimension, feature, or structure data and their
registration. Use `minecraft-datapack` for non-worldgen data and
`minecraft-modding` for non-worldgen gameplay code.
## Routing Boundaries
- `Use when`: the task changes worldgen data, registration, or injection.
- `Do not use when`: the task is non-worldgen datapack work (`minecraft-datapack`).
- `Do not use when`: the task is non-worldgen mod systems (`minecraft-modding`).
## Choose the delivery path
| Approach | Best When | Platform |
|----------|-----------|----------|
| Datapack JSON | Change data supplied by a pack | Vanilla, any server |
| **Mod + Datagen** | Registering new biomes/dimensions, code-driven | NeoForge / Fabric |
| **Biome Modifier (NeoForge)** | Adding features/spawns to existing biomes | NeoForge |
| **BiomeModification API (Fabric)** | Adding features/spawns to existing biomes | Fabric |
Worldgen registries are datapack registries: their files load at world load and
their registry path determines the data path. Read the [NeoForge registry
guide](https://docs.neoforged.net/docs/concepts/registries/) before choosing a
mod-specific registry path.
## Version boundary
Use Minecraft 26.x for new work. Use Java 25 and start
each JSON schema from the exact target's vanilla data or generated output. Do
not copy a 1.21 shape into a 26.x pack merely because it parses as JSON.
Preserve an established 1.21.x project on Java 21 and its matching schema unless
the task explicitly includes an upgrade. Keep examples matched to the project version.
The [26.1 migration primer](https://docs.neoforged.net/primer/docs/26.1/)
removes `minecraft:random_patch` and `minecraft:no_bonemeal_flower`. It replaces
the random-patch pattern with a separate `minecraft:simple_block` configured
feature and placements for count, random offset, and block-predicate filtering.
Inspect the relevant primer section before migrating code or data.
Read [legacy 1.21 JSON patterns](references/legacy-1.21-worldgen-json.md) only
when the project targets that version. Those examples are not
release artifacts for 26.x.
---
## Data layout and reference graph
26.3 uses `worldgen/feature/`; through 26.2 this was `worldgen/configured_feature/`.
In 26.3, feature fields are at the root, block states use `id` / `properties`,
and biome spawn settings belong in environment attributes. See the
[26.3 migration primer](https://docs.neoforged.net/primer/docs/26.3/).
```
data/<namespace>/
├── worldgen/
│   ├── biome/
│   │   └── my_biome.json
│   ├── feature/
│   │   └── my_ore.json
│   ├── placed_feature/
│   │   └── my_ore_placed.json
│   ├── noise_settings/
│   │   └── my_dimension_noise.json
│   ├── structure/
│   │   └── my_structure.json
│   ├── structure_set/
│   │   └── my_structures.json
│   ├── processor_list/
│   │   └── my_processors.json
│   ├── template_pool/
│   │   └── my_pool.json
│   └── carver/
│       └── my_carver.json
├── dimension/
│   └── my_dimension.json
├── dimension_type/
│   └── my_type.json
├── tags/
│   └── worldgen/
│       └── biome/
│           └── is_forest.json
└── neoforge/
    └── biome_modifier/      (NeoForge mod only)
        └── add_ores.json
```
Build and review the graph from its leaves upward:
1. Define a feature, then its placed feature.
2. Reference placed features from a biome or biome modifier at the intended
   decoration step.
3. Define a structure, then its structure set; a jigsaw structure also needs a
   template pool, processor list, and structure template.
4. Define a dimension type and noise settings before a dimension that references
   them.
Use fully qualified identifiers across namespaces. An external `minecraft:` or
dependency reference is valid when that dependency supplies the registry entry;
do not create a local copy merely to satisfy static checking. If the same pack
contains that external namespace and registry directory, treat it as local and
verify the target exists.
---

# Paper API 1.21.11 cheat sheet
Verified against paper-api-1.21.11-R0.1-SNAPSHOT (the exact jar you compile against). Names here are correct for 1.21.11; do not use names from other versions.

## Attributes (org.bukkit.attribute.Attribute)
- In 1.21.11 `Attribute` is an INTERFACE (registry-backed, not an enum). Constants have NO prefix. GENERIC_* / PLAYER_* names DO NOT EXIST here.
- Use: MAX_HEALTH, MOVEMENT_SPEED, ATTACK_DAMAGE, ATTACK_SPEED, ATTACK_KNOCKBACK, ARMOR, ARMOR_TOUGHNESS, KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE, SCALE, JUMP_STRENGTH, GRAVITY, STEP_HEIGHT, SAFE_FALL_DISTANCE, FALL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER, FOLLOW_RANGE, FLYING_SPEED, LUCK, BLOCK_BREAK_SPEED, BLOCK_INTERACTION_RANGE, ENTITY_INTERACTION_RANGE, SNEAKING_SPEED, SPAWN_REINFORCEMENTS, TEMPT_RANGE, CAMERA_DISTANCE.
- Keys: minecraft:scale, minecraft:max_health (no 'generic.'). `Attribute.valueOf/values()` are deprecated for removal and you cannot `switch` on an Attribute: look up by key with `Registry.ATTRIBUTE.get(NamespacedKey.minecraft("scale"))` (may return null).
- `entity.getAttribute(attr)` returns AttributeInstance or null: always null-check. Methods: getBaseValue(), setBaseValue(double), getValue(), getDefaultValue(), addModifier(m), addTransientModifier(m), removeModifier(Key), getModifier(Key), getModifiers().
- Modifiers: `new AttributeModifier(new NamespacedKey(plugin, "growth"), amount, AttributeModifier.Operation.ADD_NUMBER)` (optional 4th arg EquipmentSlotGroup). Operations: ADD_NUMBER, ADD_SCALAR, MULTIPLY_SCALAR_1. The UUID/String constructors are deprecated for removal. Remove the old modifier with `removeModifier(key)` before adding it again with the same key.
- Size changes: the default scale is 1.0; setBaseValue on the scale attribute or use one keyed modifier. Max health: set the attribute first, then `setHealth(Math.min(h, attr.getValue()))`.

## Sounds (org.bukkit.Sound)
- In 1.21.11 `Sound` is an INTERFACE, not an enum: no `switch`, `Sound.valueOf/values()` are deprecated for removal. Look up config names with `Registry.SOUNDS.get(NamespacedKey.minecraft("entity.player.levelup"))` (may be null).
- e.g. ENTITY_PLAYER_LEVELUP, BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_PLING, BLOCK_NOTE_BLOCK_HAT, UI_BUTTON_CLICK, UI_TOAST_CHALLENGE_COMPLETE, ENTITY_EXPERIENCE_ORB_PICKUP, ENTITY_ENDER_DRAGON_GROWL, ENTITY_WITHER_SPAWN, ENTITY_ENDERMAN_TELEPORT, ENTITY_VILLAGER_NO.
- `player.playSound(player.getLocation(), Sound.X, 1f, 1f)`. Version-proof for config strings: `player.playSound(net.kyori.adventure.sound.Sound.sound(Key.key(name), net.kyori.adventure.sound.Sound.Source.MASTER, 1f, 1f))`.

## Particles (org.bukkit.Particle, an enum in every version)
- Old names DO NOT EXIST. Old -> new: REDSTONE->DUST, SPELL_WITCH->WITCH, VILLAGER_HAPPY->HAPPY_VILLAGER, VILLAGER_ANGRY->ANGRY_VILLAGER, SMOKE_NORMAL->SMOKE, SMOKE_LARGE->LARGE_SMOKE, EXPLOSION_NORMAL->POOF, FIREWORKS_SPARK->FIREWORK, ENCHANTMENT_TABLE->ENCHANT, TOTEM->TOTEM_OF_UNDYING, ITEM_CRACK->ITEM, BLOCK_CRACK->BLOCK, SPELL_MOB->ENTITY_EFFECT, CRIT_MAGIC->ENCHANTED_HIT, DRIP_WATER->DRIPPING_WATER. Unchanged: FLAME, HEART, NOTE, CRIT, END_ROD, CLOUD, PORTAL, SOUL_FIRE_FLAME.
- Particles that REQUIRE data (spawning them without it fails at runtime): DUST needs `new Particle.DustOptions(Color.RED, 1.0f)`; DUST_COLOR_TRANSITION needs Particle.DustTransition; ENTITY_EFFECT needs a `Color`; ITEM needs an ItemStack; BLOCK, FALLING_DUST, BLOCK_MARKER, DUST_PILLAR need BlockData (`Material.STONE.createBlockData()`); SCULK_CHARGE needs Float; SHRIEK needs Integer; VIBRATION needs Vibration; TRAIL needs `new Particle.Trail(targetLocation, Color, durationTicks)`; BLOCK_CRUMBLE
- `world.spawnParticle(Particle.FLAME, loc, count, offX, offY, offZ, extraSpeed)`; with data: `world.spawnParticle(Particle.DUST, loc, 10, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2, 0, new Particle.DustOptions(Color.AQUA, 1f))`. For a config value use `Particle.valueOf(name.toUpperCase())` inside try/catch.

## Potion effects and enchantments (same names in all 1.21.x)
- PotionEffectType old -> new (old names DO NOT EXIST): INCREASE_DAMAGE->STRENGTH, SLOW->SLOWNESS, FAST_DIGGING->HASTE, SLOW_DIGGING->MINING_FATIGUE, JUMP->JUMP_BOOST, DAMAGE_RESISTANCE->RESISTANCE, HEAL->INSTANT_HEALTH, HARM->INSTANT_DAMAGE, CONFUSION->NAUSEA. Unchanged: SPEED, REGENERATION, FIRE_RESISTANCE, INVISIBILITY, NIGHT_VISION, GLOWING, LEVITATION, SLOW_FALLING. New in 1.21.11: BREATH_OF_THE_NAUTILUS.
- `new PotionEffect(PotionEffectType.SPEED, 30 * 20, 1)` = Speed II for 30 s (amplifier 0 = level I). Extra ctor args: (type, ticks, amp, ambient, particles, icon). `PotionEffect.INFINITE_DURATION` exists. `entity.addPotionEffect(effect)`. getByName is deprecated: for config strings use `Registry.EFFECT.get(NamespacedKey.minecraft("speed"))` (or Registry.MOB_EFFECT).
- Enchantment old -> new (old names DO NOT EXIST): DAMAGE_ALL->SHARPNESS, DAMAGE_UNDEAD->SMITE, DAMAGE_ARTHROPODS->BANE_OF_ARTHROPODS, DURABILITY->UNBREAKING, DIG_SPEED->EFFICIENCY, LOOT_BONUS_BLOCKS->FORTUNE, LOOT_BONUS_MOBS->LOOTING, ARROW_DAMAGE->POWER, ARROW_KNOCKBACK->PUNCH, ARROW_FIRE->FLAME, ARROW_INFINITE->INFINITY, PROTECTION_ENVIRONMENTAL->PROTECTION, PROTECTION_FALL->FEATHER_FALLING, OXYGEN->RESPIRATION, WATER_WORKER->AQUA_AFFINITY. Unchanged: MENDING, SILK_TOUCH, FIRE_ASPECT, KNOCKBA
- `meta.addEnchant(Enchantment.SHARPNESS, 5, true)` (true = ignore level limits) or `item.addUnsafeEnchantment(ench, level)`. Enchantment.getByName and Registry.ENCHANTMENT are deprecated; for config strings use `RegistryAccess.registryAccess().getRegistry(RegistryKey.ENCHANTMENT).get(NamespacedKey.minecraft("sharpness"))` (io.papermc.paper.registry).

## Materials and entity types
- Material.SHORT_GRASS (plain GRASS does not exist), GRASS_BLOCK, CLOCK, PLAYER_HEAD, SPAWNER, TURTLE_SCUTE, ARMADILLO_SCUTE. CHAIN was renamed: use Material.IRON_CHAIN in 1.21.11.
- EntityType: ITEM (not DROPPED_ITEM), FIREWORK_ROCKET, TNT, LIGHTNING_BOLT, SNOW_GOLEM, MOOSHROOM, END_CRYSTAL, EXPERIENCE_ORB, FISHING_BOBBER, ARMOR_STAND, CREAKING. Boats are per wood: OAK_BOAT, SPRUCE_BOAT, ..., OAK_CHEST_BOAT, BAMBOO_RAFT (BOAT/CHEST_BOAT do not exist). Thrown potions: SPLASH_POTION, LINGERING_POTION (POTION no longer exists).
- Spawning: `world.spawn(loc, Zombie.class, z -> { z.customName(Component.text("Giant", NamedTextColor.RED)); z.setCustomNameVisible(true); })` configures the mob before it appears. Get the killer with `entity.getKiller()` (Player or null).
- `world.setGameRule(GameRules.KEEP_INVENTORY, true)` with org.bukkit.GameRules (the GameRule.* constants are deprecated for removal in 1.21.11; see the gamerule names below). PVP is new in 1.21.11; SPAWN_CHUNK_RADIUS was removed. The String getGameRuleValue/setGameRuleValue are deprecated for removal. Time/weather: world.setTime(1000)/setTime(13000), setStorm(false), setThundering(false).

## Text: Adventure Components (never ChatColor or String setters)
- `Component.text("Hi", NamedTextColor.GREEN)`, `.append(...)`, `.decorate(TextDecoration.BOLD)`; MiniMessage: `MiniMessage.miniMessage().deserialize("<gold>Hi <player>", Placeholder.unparsed("player", name))`. Config text with & codes: `LegacyComponentSerializer.legacyAmpersand().deserialize(s)`. Plain string from a Component: `PlainTextComponentSerializer.plainText().serialize(c)`.
- Send: player.sendMessage(Component), Bukkit.broadcast(Component), player.sendActionBar(Component), player.showTitle(Title.title(main, sub, Title.Times.times(Duration.ofMillis(500), Duration.ofSeconds(3), Duration.ofMillis(500)))). Tab name: player.playerListName(Component). Team prefix: team.prefix(Component).
- Deprecated String APIs (avoid): ChatColor, Bukkit.broadcastMessage, sendTitle(String..), setDisplayName/setPlayerListName/setLore(String), setJoinMessage/setQuitMessage/setDeathMessage, createInventory(holder, size, String), Team.setPrefix(String). Use the Component versions: joinMessage(c), quitMessage(c), deathMessage(c), meta.displayName(c), meta.lore(list).
- Chat: listen to `io.papermc.paper.event.player.AsyncChatEvent` (AsyncPlayerChatEvent is deprecated). `event.message()` / `event.message(Component)`, `event.setCancelled(true)`, `event.renderer((source, displayName, message, viewer) -> ...)`. It runs off the main thread: read only thread-safe data (use a ConcurrentHashMap) and hop back with `Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask(plugin, ...)` before touching players/worlds.

## Commands (the build validates plugin.yml)
- Declare every command in plugin.yml (`commands: name: {description, usage, permission}`) and register with `getCommand("name").setExecutor(handler)` (+ `.setTabCompleter`). Implement `onCommand(CommandSender sender, Command command, String label, String[] args)`; check `if (!(sender instanceof Player player))` for player-only commands; validate args.length and parse numbers inside try/catch. Subcommands: switch on args[0].
- Do not use Brigadier, LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS or JavaPlugin.registerCommand(BasicCommand): the build service only accepts plugin.yml commands.

## Scheduler, threads, data, config
- `Bukkit.getScheduler().runTaskTimer(plugin, () -> {...}, delayTicks, periodTicks)` (20 ticks = 1 s), runTaskLater, runTask; or `new BukkitRunnable(){ public void run(){... cancel(); } }.runTaskTimer(plugin, 0L, 20L)`. Keep the BukkitTask to cancel it. Start a BukkitRunnable with its own runTaskTimer(plugin, ...); passing a BukkitRunnable to the scheduler's runTask*/runTaskTimer throws UnsupportedOperationException at runtime. runTaskAsynchronously only for file IO, never Bukkit API calls. Serv
- PersistentDataContainer: `NamespacedKey key = new NamespacedKey(plugin, "soulbound")`; `ItemMeta m = item.getItemMeta(); m.getPersistentDataContainer().set(key, PersistentDataType.BOOLEAN, true); item.setItemMeta(m);` then `pdc.has(key, PersistentDataType.BOOLEAN)` / `pdc.get(key, type)` / `getOrDefault`. Types: BYTE, SHORT, INTEGER, LONG, FLOAT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, STRING, BYTE_ARRAY, INTEGER_ARRAY, LONG_ARRAY, TAG_CONTAINER, LIST (`PersistentDataType.LIST.strings()`). Players and entities have 
- Config: put defaults in src/main/resources/config.yml, call saveDefaultConfig() in onEnable, read with getConfig().getInt("path", def) / getString / getStringList / getConfigurationSection(path) (may be null), reloadConfig() on /x reload. The class is `org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration` (NOT org.bukkit.configuration.FileConfiguration).
- Data files: `File f = new File(getDataFolder(), "data.yml"); YamlConfiguration y = YamlConfiguration.loadConfiguration(f); ... y.save(f)` (save throws IOException: catch it). Store per-player data under the UUID string. Locations and ItemStacks can be stored directly: y.set("home", loc), y.getLocation("home"), y.getItemStack("item").

## Events you will commonly need
- Register: `getServer().getPluginManager().registerEvents(listener, this)`; methods annotated `@EventHandler` (optionally `(ignoreCancelled = true, priority = EventPriority.HIGH)`).
- PlayerJoinEvent (player.hasPlayedBefore()), PlayerQuitEvent, PlayerDeathEvent (getPlayer(), getDrops(), getItemsToKeep(), setKeepInventory(bool), deathMessage(Component)), PlayerRespawnEvent (setRespawnLocation), EntityDeathEvent (getEntity().getKiller(), getDrops()), EntityDamageEvent (getCause() == EntityDamageEvent.DamageCause.FALL), EntityDamageByEntityEvent (getDamager() may be a Projectile: check `instanceof Projectile p && p.getShooter() instanceof Player`), BlockBreakEvent, BlockPlaceE
- TNTPrimeEvent (org.bukkit.event.block): getCause(), getPrimingEntity(), getPrimingBlock(). There is NO getIgnitingEntity().

## Menus (chest GUIs)
- Make a holder class: `class Menu implements InventoryHolder { final Inventory inv = Bukkit.createInventory(this, 27, Component.text("Warps")); public Inventory getInventory(){ return inv; } }` (size a multiple of 9, max 54). Open with player.openInventory(menu.getInventory()).
- In InventoryClickEvent: `if (!(event.getInventory().getHolder(false) instanceof Menu menu)) return; event.setCancelled(true);` then use getRawSlot() (< inventory size = top menu), getCurrentItem() (may be null), isLeftClick()/isRightClick()/isShiftClick(), `event.getWhoClicked()` (cast to Player). Also cancel InventoryDragEvent for menus. Never identify menus by title.

## Items and recipes
- `ItemStack.of(Material.DIAMOND, 5)` or `new ItemStack(mat, n)`. `item.editMeta(meta -> { meta.displayName(Component.text("Super", NamedTextColor.GOLD).decoration(TextDecoration.ITALIC, false)); meta.lore(List.of(Component.text("..."))); meta.setUnbreakable(true); meta.addItemFlags(ItemFlag.HIDE_ENCHANTS); meta.setEnchantmentGlintOverride(true); })`. getItemMeta() is null for AIR. Hand: player.getInventory().getItemInMainHand() (getItemInHand is deprecated); setHelmet(item).
- 1.21.11 also has ItemMeta.customName(Component), setItemModel(NamespacedKey), setEquippable, setUseCooldown, setGlider and io.papermc.paper.datacomponent.DataComponentTypes (experimental: prefer ItemMeta). setCustomModelData(Integer) is deprecated here (use CustomModelDataComponent) but compiles.
- give items: `player.getInventory().addItem(item)` returns leftovers (HashMap) to drop with world.dropItemNaturally. `player.give(items)` also exists.
- Recipes: `ShapedRecipe r = new ShapedRecipe(new NamespacedKey(plugin, "super_pickaxe"), result); r.shape("DDD", " S ", " S "); r.setIngredient('D', Material.DIAMOND_BLOCK); r.setIngredient('S', Material.STICK); Bukkit.addRecipe(r);` unlock with player.discoverRecipe(key); Bukkit.removeRecipe(key) in onDisable. ShapedRecipe(ItemStack) without a key is deprecated.

## Boss bars and scoreboards
- Adventure boss bar: `BossBar bar = BossBar.bossBar(Component.text("Boss"), 1.0f, BossBar.Color.RED, BossBar.Overlay.PROGRESS); player.showBossBar(bar); bar.progress(f); player.hideBossBar(bar);` progress must stay within 0..1 (clamp it). Colors PINK BLUE RED GREEN YELLOW PURPLE WHITE; overlays PROGRESS, NOTCHED_6/10/12/20. Hide it from everyone when done and in onDisable.
- Sidebar: `Scoreboard sb = Bukkit.getScoreboardManager().getNewScoreboard(); Objective o = sb.registerNewObjective("side", Criteria.DUMMY, Component.text("Title")); o.setDisplaySlot(DisplaySlot.SIDEBAR); o.numberFormat(NumberFormat.blank()); o.getScore("line").setScore(3); player.setScoreboard(sb);` (NumberFormat is io.papermc.paper.scoreboard.numbers.NumberFormat). The registerNewObjective overloads that take a criteria String are deprecated. Score entries must be unique strings (max 15 lines)

## Main class traps
- JavaPlugin defines final isEnabled(), setEnabled(boolean), getServer(), getDataFolder(), getDescription(), plus getConfig(), saveConfig(), reloadConfig(), getLogger(), getName(), getCommand(). Do not declare methods with those names in your main class (use names like isFeatureOn()).

<!-- mc-coverage:begin -->
## Events catalog (main thread unless ASYNC; cancel only what implements Cancellable)
- Players: PlayerJoinEvent, PlayerQuitEvent, PlayerChangedWorldEvent (getFrom()), PlayerTeleportEvent (getFrom/getTo/getCause), PlayerRespawnEvent, PlayerDeathEvent, PlayerInteractEvent (Action.PHYSICAL = pressure plates, fires repeatedly: debounce), PlayerInteractEntityEvent (check getHand() == EquipmentSlot.HAND), PlayerSwapHandItemsEvent (the F key; cancel it to keep the items where they are), PlayerToggleSneakEvent, PlayerItemConsumeEvent (cancelling also cancels eating: add extra effects on
- ASYNC (never touch worlds/entities/inventories; hop back with runTask): AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent (before the player exists: event.disallow(AsyncPlayerPreLoginEvent.Result.KICK_OTHER, Component)), AsyncChatEvent, AsyncTabCompleteEvent.
- Blocks: BlockBreakEvent (setDropItems(false)), BlockPlaceEvent, BlockDropItemEvent (getBlockState() = the broken block), SignChangeEvent (line(i) / line(i, Component)), BlockPistonExtendEvent / BlockPistonRetractEvent (getBlocks(), getDirection(): protect claims against pistons), BlockFromToEvent (flowing liquids), BlockBurnEvent, EntityChangeBlockEvent, InventoryMoveItemEvent (hoppers: fires constantly, keep it cheap).
- Entities: CreatureSpawnEvent (getSpawnReason(): NATURAL, SPAWNER, SPAWNER_EGG, BREEDING, COMMAND, CUSTOM = plugins; limit NATURAL/SPAWNER, never eggs or commands), SpawnerSpawnEvent, EntityTargetEvent, EntityShootBowEvent (getForce() 0..1, getProjectile()), ProjectileLaunchEvent, ProjectileHitEvent, PotionSplashEvent, EntityRegainHealthEvent.
- Inventory: InventoryOpenEvent (cancellable), InventoryClickEvent, InventoryDragEvent, InventoryCloseEvent (save storage menus here), PrepareAnvilEvent.
- World / server: WorldLoadEvent, WorldUnloadEvent, ChunkLoadEvent (isNewChunk()) / ChunkUnloadEvent (never load other chunks inside them), ServerLoadEvent (after every plugin enabled), PluginEnableEvent / PluginDisableEvent (soft integrations).

## Blocks, chunks, worlds, structures
- BlockFace: block.getRelative(BlockFace.DOWN), face.getOppositeFace(); yaw to a face: SOUTH, WEST, NORTH, EAST for 0, 90, 180, 270. block.setType(mat, false) skips physics; getBlockData()/setBlockData(data, false); Material.STONE.createBlockData().
- BlockState: block.getState() is a SNAPSHOT (change it, then state.update()); block.getState(false) is a live view (no update(), do not keep it). Check `instanceof Container / Chest / Sign / CreatureSpawner / TileState`; a TileState has its own PersistentDataContainer (call update() after changing it on a snapshot).
- Signs: sign.getSide(Side.FRONT).line(0) (org.bukkit.block.sign.Side) or .line(0, Component).
- Chunks: block.getChunk().getChunkKey() (a long, unique per world), world.getChunkAtAsync(x, z).thenAccept(c -> ...), chunk.getEntities(), world.setChunkForceLoaded(x, z, true) (undo it).

## Item metas, potions, books, trades
- Typed metas: item.editMeta(SkullMeta.class, m -> m.setOwningPlayer(offlinePlayer)); PotionMeta: setBasePotionType(PotionType.AWKWARD), addCustomEffect(effect, true), setColor(Color); LeatherArmorMeta.setColor(Color.fromRGB(0xD2501E)); BookMeta on WRITTEN_BOOK: title(Component), author(Component), pages(List<Component>). Open a book without an item: player.openBook(net.kyori.adventure.inventory.Book.book(title, author, pages)).
- Brewing recipes: Bukkit.getPotionBrewer().addPotionMix(new io.papermc.paper.potion.PotionMix(key, result, new RecipeChoice.ExactChoice(input), new RecipeChoice.MaterialChoice(Material.X))); removePotionMix(key) in onDisable.
- Villager trades: new MerchantRecipe(result, maxUses) + addIngredient(stack); villager.getRecipes() is a copy: build a list and setRecipes(list); VillagerAcquireTradeEvent when it gains a trade.
- Custom trade menu on this version: Merchant m = Bukkit.createMerchant(); m.setRecipes(list); MenuType.MERCHANT.builder().title(Component.text("Shop")).merchant(m).checkReachable(false).build(player).open(); (org.bukkit.inventory.MenuType). Bukkit.createMerchant(Component) and player.openMerchant(merchant, true) are deprecated here.
- Item components: meta.setMaxStackSize(n), setRarity(ItemRarity.RARE), setDamageResistant(DamageTypeTags.IS_FIRE) (setFireResistant is deprecated here), setGlider(true), setUseCooldown, setEquippable(EquippableComponent: setSlot, setModel(asset key) for worn looks), setTool, setJukeboxPlayable. Edible custom items: meta.setFood(food with nutrition/saturation) AND item.setData(DataComponentTypes.CONSUMABLE, Consumable.consumable().consumeSeconds(1.6f).build()) (io.papermc.paper.datacomponent; Fo

## Players by name, data, other plugins, displays
- NEVER Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer(String name): it can block the server on a web lookup. Online: Bukkit.getPlayerExact(name). Known offline: Bukkit.getOfflinePlayerIfCached(name) (null if they never joined). Store players by UUID; Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer(UUID) is safe (getName() may be null).
- Data: YamlConfiguration files for small data. Per-player data that grows: one JSON file per UUID with com.google.gson.Gson (on the classpath) at getDataFolder()/players/<uuid>.json; load on join, save on quit and on a timer; do the file IO in runTaskAsynchronously on a COPY of the data.
- Tags on items/entities/blocks: PersistentDataContainer only. setMetadata/FixedMetadataValue is in memory (gone after a restart) and deprecated on 1.21.11.
- Offer an API to other plugins: getServer().getServicesManager().register(MyApi.class, impl, this, ServicePriority.Normal); others read it with getServicesManager().load(MyApi.class) (null if absent); unregisterAll(this) in onDisable. Optional plugin present: getServer().getPluginManager().getPlugin("Name") != null. No reflection (the safety scan blocks it).
- Keyed Bukkit boss bar (stays in the world across reloads): Bukkit.createBossBar(new NamespacedKey(plugin, "info"), "title", BarColor.BLUE, BarStyle.SEGMENTED_10); remove with Bukkit.removeBossBar(key) in onDisable. Prefer the Adventure BossBar for per-player bars.
- Tab list: player.sendPlayerListHeaderAndFooter(header, footer); player.playerListName(Component).
- Display entities: world.spawn(loc, TextDisplay.class, d -> { d.text(c); d.setBillboard(Display.Billboard.CENTER); }) (holograms), ItemDisplay (props/furniture: setItemStack, setTransformation(new Transformation(new Vector3f(), new AxisAngle4f(rad, 0, 1, 0), new Vector3f(1, 1, 1), new AxisAngle4f())) with org.joml), Interaction (a click box: setInteractionWidth/Height, setResponsive(true), clicks arrive as PlayerInteractEntityEvent; a player can ride it as a seat). setTeleportDuration(ticks) ma
- Player.isOnGround() is deprecated (the client reports it): check the block below or the velocity instead.
- Bans: offlinePlayer.ban(reason, Duration.ofHours(h), source) on a known player (getPlayerExact / getOfflinePlayerIfCached); a ban list entry for a name-only profile (Bukkit.createProfile(name)) throws. Mutes and freezes are the mod's own state.
- There are NO always-loaded spawn chunks on this version: entities (displays, NPCs, props) spawned where no player is unload at once. Spawn them near players, or keep the chunk loaded with chunk.addPluginChunkTicket(plugin) and remove the ticket (world.removePluginChunkTickets(plugin)) when they go.
- Steering a ridden entity: player.getCurrentInput() (org.bukkit.Input: isForward, isBackward, isLeft, isRight, isJump, isSneak, isSprint) or PlayerInputEvent; armour changes: EntityEquipmentChangedEvent or com.destroystokyo.paper.event.player.PlayerArmorChangeEvent (re-check one tick later).

rules-2026-10-11.2 Short imperative rules learned from real Mod Builder failures. Reviewed by a human before they land here (candidates come from tools/mine-rules.py). 'versions' is a list of exact Paper versions the rule applies to, or ["*"]. A rule with 'pattern' is also enforced by the pre-compile check (precheck.j
attr-generic-prefix-old | ['1.21.1'] | On 1.21.1 Attribute is an enum with prefixed names: use Attribute.GENERIC_MAX_HEALTH, GENERIC_SCALE, GENERIC_MOVEMENT_SPEED, GENERIC_ATTACK_DAMAGE, GENERIC_JUMP
attr-generic-prefix-new | ['1.21.4', '1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | On 1.21.4 and newer Attribute names have no prefix: use Attribute.MAX_HEALTH, SCALE, MOVEMENT_SPEED, JUMP_STRENGTH, KNOCKBACK_RESISTANCE (GENERIC_*/PLAYER_* do 
attr-no-switch-new | ['1.21.4', '1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | On 1.21.4 and newer Attribute and Sound are interfaces, not enums: never switch on them or call Attribute.valueOf/Sound.valueOf; look config names up with Regis
fileconfiguration-package | ['*'] | FileConfiguration and YamlConfiguration live in org.bukkit.configuration.file (import org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration).
tntprime-priming-entity | ['*'] | TNTPrimeEvent has getPrimingEntity(), getPrimingBlock() and getCause(); there is no getIgnitingEntity().
main-class-reserved-methods | ['*'] | Never declare isEnabled(), setEnabled(), getServer(), getDataFolder(), getDescription(), getPluginMeta() or getLifecycleManager() in the main class: JavaPlugin 
chain-renamed | ['1.21.11'] | On 1.21.11 Material.CHAIN was renamed to Material.IRON_CHAIN.
potion-entity-split | ['1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | On 1.21.8 and newer EntityType.POTION is gone: use EntityType.SPLASH_POTION or LINGERING_POTION.
boat-split | ['1.21.4', '1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | On 1.21.4 and newer boats are per wood type (EntityType.OAK_BOAT, OAK_CHEST_BOAT, ...): EntityType.BOAT/CHEST_BOAT do not exist.
brigadier-commands | ['*'] | Register commands only through plugin.yml + getCommand(name).setExecutor(...); do not use Brigadier, LifecycleEvents.COMMANDS or registerCommand(BasicCommand).
particle-old-names | ['*'] | Use modern Particle names: DUST (needs Particle.DustOptions), WITCH, HAPPY_VILLAGER, SMOKE, POOF, FIREWORK, ENCHANT, TOTEM_OF_UNDYING, ITEM, BLOCK, ENTITY_EFFEC
potion-old-names | ['*'] | Use modern PotionEffectType names: STRENGTH, SLOWNESS, HASTE, MINING_FATIGUE, JUMP_BOOST, RESISTANCE, INSTANT_HEALTH, INSTANT_DAMAGE, NAUSEA.
enchant-old-names | ['*'] | Use modern Enchantment names: SHARPNESS, UNBREAKING, EFFICIENCY, FORTUNE, LOOTING, POWER, PROTECTION, FEATHER_FALLING.
short-grass | ['*'] | Material.GRASS does not exist: the plant is Material.SHORT_GRASS, the block is Material.GRASS_BLOCK.
numberformat-package | ['*'] | NumberFormat (hide sidebar score numbers) is io.papermc.paper.scoreboard.numbers.NumberFormat, not org.bukkit.scoreboard: objective.numberFormat(NumberFormat.bl
bossbar-viewers | ['*'] | Adventure BossBar.viewers() returns BossBarViewer objects, not Audience/Player: track who sees a bar in your own Set<UUID> (or call hideBossBar on each online p
ondisable-sync-save | ['*'] | In onDisable save data synchronously (call your save method directly): the scheduler refuses new tasks while the plugin is disabling (IllegalPluginAccessExcepti
scheduler-bukkitrunnable | ['*'] | Start a BukkitRunnable with its own method (new MyTask().runTaskTimer(plugin, 0L, 20L)); never pass a BukkitRunnable to Bukkit.getScheduler().runTask*/runTaskTi
offline-player-by-name | ['*'] | Never call Bukkit.getOfflinePlayer(String name): it may block the main thread on a Mojang lookup. Online players: Bukkit.getPlayerExact(name); known offline pla
legacy-color-codes | ['*'] | Colour codes from config (&a, &l): LegacyComponentSerializer.legacyAmpersand().deserialize(text) -> Component; never ChatColor.translateAlternateColorCodes.
player-spigot | ['*'] | Clickable/hover chat uses Adventure (Component.clickEvent / hoverEvent), never player.spigot() or net.md_5.bungee.api.chat.
playermove-unfiltered | ['*'] | Every PlayerMoveEvent handler starts with `if (!event.hasChangedBlock()) return;` (or hasChangedPosition()).
async-bukkit-api | ['*'] | Inside runTaskAsynchronously only file IO and pure computation; every world/entity/inventory/player call goes back to the main thread with runTask.
async-player-chat-event | ['*'] | AsyncPlayerChatEvent is deprecated: listen to io.papermc.paper.event.player.AsyncChatEvent and change the look with event.renderer(...) / event.message(Componen
registry-lookup-by-name | ['*'] | Look registry content up by key: Registry.EFFECT / Registry.ENTITY_TYPE / Registry.SOUNDS / Registry.ATTRIBUTE / Registry.VILLAGER_PROFESSION .get(NamespacedKey
merchant-menu-type | ['1.21.4', '1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | Custom merchant menus on 1.21.4+: Bukkit.createMerchant() + MenuType.MERCHANT.builder().title(..).merchant(m).build(player).open(); createMerchant(Component)/op
registry-no-switch | ['*'] | Villager.Profession, Villager.Type and Cat.Type (every 1.21.x) and Biome, Sound, Attribute (1.21.4+) are registry interfaces: never switch on them; compare with
no-server-internals | ['*'] | Never touch NMS/CraftBukkit (net.minecraft.*, org.bukkit.craftbukkit.*, getHandle()): use the Paper API, and put what is impossible without internals in "limita
reflection-alternative | ['*'] | No reflection: other plugins' APIs come from the ServicesManager (getServicesManager().load(Type.class)), version checks from Bukkit.getMinecraftVersion(), opti
networking-alternative | ['*'] | No networking (webhooks, update checkers, metrics, vote listeners): build the in-game part and explain the safe alternative in "limitations".
gamerule-constants-1-21-11 | ['1.21.11'] | On 1.21.11 set gamerules with org.bukkit.GameRules.* (GameRule.* constants are deprecated for removal; several were renamed, e.g. DO_DAYLIGHT_CYCLE -> GameRules
food-eat-seconds-moved | ['1.21.4', '1.21.8', '1.21.11'] | Edible custom items: on 1.21.1 FoodComponent.setEatSeconds makes any item edible; on 1.21.4+ eating is the consumable data component (item.setData(DataComponent
perf-unbounded-fanout | ['*'] | Never copy, mirror or replay block changes or mob spawns into every chunk, every loaded chunk or the whole world, and never iterate world.getLoadedChunks()/worl

cd /tank/cyrus-library-staging/_reference-mods/; python3 - <<'E'
import zipfile, json, glob, re, collections, os
want="dynamic-lights spawn-animations true-ending daycounter tool-trims guns_plus_plus osc-dp vanilla-backpacks mastercutter players-drop-heads armor-stand-arms mob-captains toolbar-sounds tree-vein-miner x_ray villager-transportation edf-remastered better-caps blossom-blade incendium tectonic dungeons-and-taverns terralith nullscape stellarity dynamic-torches norollback vanilla-refresh improved-pillager-outpost typewriter-daycounter fokusapi hearths from-the-fog ibo remove-terralith-intro-message".split()
cat={}
for l in open('catalog.jsonl'):
    r=json.loads(l); cat[r['slug']]=r
for s in want:
    r=cat.get(s)
    if not r: print('MISSING',s); continue
    p=r['staged_path']
    try: z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
    except Exception as e: print(s,'ERR',e); continue
    names=z.namelist()
    reg=collections.Counter()
    ns=set()
    for n in names:
        m=re.match(r'(?:[^/]+/)?data/([^/]+)/(.+?)/',n)
        if m: 
            ns.add(m.group(1)); reg[m.group(2).split('/')[0] if m.group(2).startswith('worldgen') is False else 'worldgen/'+m.group(2).split('/')[1] if '/' in m.group(2) else m.group(2)]+=1
    mc=None
    for n in names:
        if n.endswith('pack.mcmeta'):
            try: mc=json.loads(z.read(n).decode('utf8','ignore'))
            except: mc='bad'
            break
    keys=list(mc.keys()) if isinstance(mc,dict) else mc
    pk=list(mc['pack'].keys()) if isinstance(mc,dict) and 'pack' in mc else None
    ov='overlays' in (mc or {}) if isinstance(mc,dict) else None
    print(f"## {s} files={len(names)} ns={sorted(ns)[:6]} mcmeta={keys} pack={pk} overlays={ov}")
    print('   ', dict(reg.most_common(12)))
E

I'm noting that Mannequin only appears in the 1.21.11 row despite existing since 1.21.9+, and that U is absent for 1.21.8. Now I'm planning a Python script to generate roughly 140 compact entries using a helper function that encodes fields like id, name, source, label, API version, lane, coverage, and gotchas.

I'm mapping source abbreviations to readable names (universal-modder, MJP, J907, BA, BB, BD, MF, corpus) and defining lane categories like plugin, texture, model3d, and config, with room for new ones. I'm cross-checking version facts -- Dialog API landing in 1.21.8, vanilla dialogs in 1.21.6, PlayerInputEvent and item_model in 1.21.4+, equippable varying between Paper and vanilla -- and deciding to label entries V, V-s, or U depending on verification confidence. Now I'm starting to draft the actual plugin-category entries, beginning with a safe async teleport pattern referencing MJP and corpus usage counts.

I'm working through a list of plugin archetypes, checking each one against coverage data: teleport warmup/cooldown is covered, combat-tag damage attribution is missing and needs references to DamageSource and kick-cause APIs, chest GUI anti-dupe is covered under design-menu, and the dialog API items are partially covered with gaps around pause-screen bootstrapping and the fact that custom click callbacks run off the main thread. I'm also noting several deliberately-missing categories like Brigadier commands, plugin.yml bootstrapping, and Folia schedulers, while flagging config snapshot/reload as partially covered through the designer-config component.

Continuing down the list, I note MiniMessage/lang.yml support is only partial, service API linkage is covered, and soft-depend bridging to third-party APIs like PlaceholderAPI is intentionally excluded since those aren't on the classpath. SQLite write-behind and economy ledger handling are partial, while escrow trading, embedded HTTP, Discord webhooks, and packet filtering are all missing or impossible due to networking restrictions, and per-player visual effects like worldborder vignettes and time/weather syncing remain uncovered.

I'm also checking per-viewer entity hiding (partial), noting that MockBukkit staging is missing infrastructure, and confirming legacy chat, async chat rendering, offline player lookup, player move filtering, registry lookups, sync saves on disable, and the BukkitRunnable trap are all covered. The batch of Paper event census items (jump/glide/riptide, item durability, block damage abort, crafting/smithing/enchant prep, portals, bucket harvest, knockback attacks, resource pack loading) is still missing and probably needs to be split into several distinct techniques rather than one.

I'm continuing to flag high-value gaps: chunk/world PDC storage for custom blocks, itemstack byte serialization for backpacks, entity snapshot pickup for mob-in-bucket mechanics, vein miner/treecapitator (top download), multi-block mining damage, lifesteal hearts via attribute modifiers (partial, not quite archetype), crate-key animations, and map image frames using MapRenderer.

I'm cataloging more gaps: sit/lay/crawl is partial via Interaction seats, oneblock/skyblock needs void chunk generators plus island structure templates, void chunk generation itself is missing with only regex-level categorization, manhunt compass tracking via lodestone, XP orb merging, anti-xray and anticheat prediction as likely impossible due to packet-level requirements, backup/rollback logging gaps like CoreProtect, inventory rollback on death/quit, and invsee.

I'm continuing through tablist/nametag coverage, holograms with per-viewer visibility as partial, chunk pregeneration being out of scope since Paper lacks an API, worldedit-style region select wands as partial overlap with claims, infinite villager trading via trade restock events as partial, and enchant registry bootstrapping being covered by datapacks instead.

I'm then working through complex custom crafting recipes as partial, bundle/backpack meta as missing, virtual spawner loot as partial, RPG skills systems as covered, ability combos as partial, mannequin-based disguises as missing until newer versions, skin changing as missing since it needs profile texture setting, MOTD handling as missing, world border expansion as missing, and login auth plugins as the next item to assess.

Continuing through the list: login auth covered as partial, vanish and permission ranks covered, sign shops partial, teams/clans and RTP covered, homes/spawn covered but portals marked missing as a custom archetype worth value 3, per-world multi-inventory also missing as an archetype worth value 3, death chests covered, PvP duels partial, leash mechanics skipped as cursed, and minigame arena resets assessed as partial using disposable world copies.

I'm flagging that generating a fresh world via WorldCreator for arena resets is a weak spot — silent terrain generation, level.dat timing, main-thread constraints — worth value 4 as its own archetype. I'm also noting testing techniques like survival bot testing, RCON ore counts, and mutant harness testing should become new test/infra entries under a "testflight" lane.

For designer components, I'm marking hitscan/beam/area_blast as missing and valuable (value 5, medium-large effort), pellet damage with noDamageTicks as covered across many plugins, charge/full-auto and arm-swing suppression as client-mod-only and not applicable to Paper, and projectile falloff as folding into area_blast. The goal-tick NMS mechanic is also being flagged as not applicable since it requires client traps, while I'm starting to review the mob AI traps list next.

Now I'm distinguishing pathfinder-based mob AI from goal-based AI as a partial coverage case, and adding mob-ai-traps as candidates for failure rules around creative targets, target reacquisition, and hurt-by ticking. I'm merging orbital strike beam mechanics into the area_blast designer composite rather than treating it separately.

Moving into items and components for Paper, I'm checking tooltip-related features: TooltipDisplay is a newer component (1.21.5+) so earlier versions rely on setHideTooltip instead, making version coverage uncertain depending on exact API level. I'm now going through armor-related gaps: armor trims (ArmorTrim, TrimPattern/Material) and their datapack and resource pack assets are missing, as is the harder case of tool trims combined with enchantments requiring bulk recipe generation. Custom damage types and custom enchantments via datapacks look covered, including enchantment tags, as do smithing transform and stonecutting recipes, potion mixing, and jukebox songs -- while painting variants, wolf variants, and banner patterns remain missing.

I'm cataloging the remaining missing datapack registries like instrument, trim_pattern/material, trial_spawner, and dialog, along with jigsaw-related structure pieces (template_pool and processor_list) which are high-value but labor-intensive worldgen features. Density function noise routers and carvers are deliberately excluded since custom noise generation isn't supported, and injecting structures into vanilla biomes is off-limits by design since only custom dimensions get edited. I'm also noting that datapack overlays tied to specific version ranges are still a gap.

Resource pack overlays, pack.mcmeta filters, and function tag load/tick behaviors are covered, but I'm flagging install/uninstall cleanup patterns, dynamic lights, and spawn animations as missing guidance, plus the macros conflict where one persona teaches them while another refuses. Moving to resource pack specifics, I'm checking item model definitions, legacy CMD overrides, and pack_format cross-referencing against registry tables across versions -- those look good. GUI sprites for boss bars and tooltip skins are missing coverage, and I'm weighing whether custom container GUI textures or the glyph title trick is the better approach for menu backgrounds.

I'm also flagging gaps around lang overrides with glyph icons, checking animated texture mcmeta coverage, and deliberately excluding core shaders and OptiFine-dependent formats like CTM/CIT/CEM since they're client-mod specific and not portable. Sky/environment textures and particle texture overrides are thin, while sounds.json event aliasing and the newer `ui` sound source category seem adequately covered.

Moving into custom blocks and entities, I'm noting noteblock and tripwire carriers are missing or only partially wired, chorus plant/mushroom block carriers are absent, and display-based custom blocks (barrier/light + item_display + interaction) are partially covered through furniture and motion systems. Seats via Interaction, BetterModel creatures, and hitboxes look reasonably covered, but custom mining speed, custom crop growth stages, fake particles, cutscenes, and vehicles are all still just partial.

Shifting to environment and cross-platform concerns, skies/fog attributes for 1.21.11 are missing, Geyser/Bedrock parity (like detecting floodgate for bedrock traps) is missing, and the client-mod .mrpack lane is a new, uncovered area.

For test and eval infrastructure, I'm checking off a long list: survival-mode bots with Mineflayer/pathfinder are missing, RCON ore counting needs verification against Cyrus's worldgen tests, mutant harness and teleport/showcase traps need grep checks, and tools like MockBukkit, Spyglass, PackSquash, spark, and Playwright need assessment against what Cyrus already has. Companion data: `BF-mc-techniques.json` (156 de-duplicated techniques; 38 covered, 41 partial, 77 missing; labels V 132, V-s 23, U 1).

Labels. **V** = verified by me this session in the repo, the 386-mod corpus (class-file constant-pool census in `_reference-mods/analysis/per_item.jsonl`, zip listings, `pack.mcmeta` key names) or in cyrus-rc2 (grep with the recipe in each `evidence` field). **V-s** = second-hand from a note or skill (universal-modder, MJP, Jahrome907, BA/BB/BD). **U** = memory/unverified. No JDK on this box, so no `javap` was run by me: Paper API claims are V only in the sense "a real plugin's compiled class references this symbol" or "Cyrus's own javap-built sheet says so"; each fact in section (c) therefore still needs the 4-jar javap check before it goes into a sheet. Corpus content was inspected structurally only (class/method names, JSON key names, file-name lists); no code or file contents were copied, and GPL/ARR projects are described in my own words.

## (a) One-page summary

* Cyrus is already far ahead of the sources on the Paper API basics. The four version sheets, 36 failure rules, 85 coverage archetypes, 65 golden plugins, the designer (items/menus/quests/bosses/HUD/motion), the datapack emitters (recipe, loot, advancement, tag, function, enchantment, damage_type, jukebox_song, predicate, item_modifier, plus an own-namespace worldgen set) and the note-block/armor generators already cover the techniques in MJP and Jahrome907. Their pack-format table matches `lib/cyrus/versions/registry.json` exactly (DP 48/61/81/94.1, RP 34/46/64/75.0).
* The remaining value is in three places: (1) **real-plugin behaviours that never reached the sheets** (about 40 Paper events and a dozen Player/World methods used by 5-60 of the 173 top plugins but absent from `sheets/1.21.11.md`); (2) **whole archetypes with big download counts and zero Cyrus text**: vein miner/tree capitator (93M downloads), pick-up-a-mob items (680k/500k/263k), crates, combat tag, skyblock/oneblock, map images, dynamic lights, lifesteal; (3) **test-method gaps** from the universal-modder field notes: the stress bot sets creative mode (verified at `stress-bot.js:80`), so mob/boss checks can give false greens; no RCON ore-count probe, no mutant self-check, no `/tick freeze` timing.

MJP-Paper-Skills (15 Paper + 16 NMS skills) is high quality and mostly confirms Cyrus rules; its unique contributions are combat tag, per-player visual effects, disposable worlds, dialog pitfalls and the Hook/Bridge/Port soft-dependency split. 9. **Ray tracing**: `World#rayTraceBlocks`, `rayTraceEntities`, `rayTrace` are referenced by 10/5/12 plugins; Cyrus Targets already uses `RayTraceResult`.
10. **Pack formats (already in registry; add as a sheet footer)**: resource 34 / 46 / 64 / 75.0, data 48 / 61 / 81 / 94.1 for 1.21.1 / .4 / .8 / .11; from 1.21.9 `min_format`/`max_format` arrays, never decimals (V-s Jahrome; V registry).

Rule candidate: before reading a height, make sure the chunk is loaded (an unloaded chunk answers with the build minimum; V-s) and assert `HeightMap.MOTION_BLOCKING_NO_LEAVES` for overworld-like worlds, scan down from `logicalHeight - 8` when `World#hasCeiling()`.

## (e) Conflicts and traps

1. **Core shaders**: BB says unsupported but working (V wiki); Jahrome says vanilla gives no supported override; corpus shows 4/43 packs ship them (glint, text, lightmap). Format changes at 1.21.2, 1.21.5, 1.21.6 and 26.x (V-s BB). Treat as per-band, client-verified, Iris/OptiFine may ignore.
2. **Dialog timeline**: vanilla 1.21.6; Paper API 1.21.7 (MJP) vs Cyrus javap "present on 1.21.8, absent on 1.21.4"; 1.21.6/7 are not in Cyrus's version set, so nothing to fix, but do not write "from 1.21.6" in a sheet.
3. **Note-block state counts**: BB 16 x 25 x 2 = 800; Cyrus reserves the 7 mob-head instruments = 350 states and its data generator lists 23 instruments on 1.21.x (16 + 7) and 27 on 26.2. Both are right for what they count; the safe reserved set is the mob-head one because vanilla only reaches it with a head above.
4. **Macros**: Jahrome's datapack skill teaches `$(arg)` macros; Cyrus's function checker refuses macro lines and `function ... with` (`functions.ts:151,258`) because commands cannot be statically checked. Keep refusing; add an eval refusal case.
5. **Commands**: MJP/Jahrome push Brigadier and `paper-plugin.yml`; Cyrus accepts plugin.yml only. 24% of corpus plugins use Brigadier, 10% paper-plugin.yml. MJP's own note: `getPlayerOrThrow()` exists only on 26.2, not 1.21.11.

Mixing the legacy numeric override and the 1.21.4 `items/` selector silently shows nothing.
7. **Equipment asset paths**: 1.21.2 used `models/equipment`, 1.21.4+ uses `assets/<ns>/equipment` (V-s BB); 1.21.1 has no equippable component (Cyrus falls back to dyed leather).
8. **Datapack folder names**: 1.21 renamed to singular (`function`, `recipe`, `loot_table`, `advancement`); 13 of 141 corpus packs ship both spellings for older versions. Cyrus emits singular only.
9. **Pack format for 1.21.9+**: `min_format`/`max_format` arrays, no decimals; a legacy range must keep `pack_format` and `supported_formats`; overlays use `min_inclusive`/`max_inclusive` objects in real packs (V corpus) and `formats` in older ones.
10. **Registry vs enum**: Attribute and Sound are enums on 1.21.1 and interfaces from 1.21.4; Villager.Profession/Type and Cat.Type interfaces on all. Already in rules; MJP/Jahrome examples written for 26.x use the interface style and would not compile on 1.21.1.
11. **Worldgen names**: Jahrome says 26.3 uses `worldgen/feature` and moved biome spawn costs to environment attributes, 1.21.11 already uses attributes for sky (Cyrus `worldgen/versions.ts`); `configured_feature` remains correct on all four supported versions.
12. **Creative-mode test false greens** (verified in stress-bot.js:80; mechanism V-s): mob targeting skips creative/spectator players; GameTest `makeMockServerPlayerInLevel()` is creative (client-mod lane only).
13. **Unloaded-chunk height query** returns the world minimum (V-s two sources); do not build a platform on it.
14. **Effects silently dropped** (virtual border, night vision, personal time) by world change, respawn, milk, `/effect clear`: reapply from a desired-state object (V-s MJP).
15. **Orphan entities**: display/seat/Interaction entities survive crashes; tag them and sweep on chunk load. Entities spawned where no player is unload at once on 1.21.11 (Cyrus sheet).
16. **Licences**: Oraxen (custom), CraftEngine (GPL-3), EliteMobs/Skript/Grim/WorldEdit/spark (GPL), PackSquash (AGPL), Blockbench (GPL) are reference-only. Corpus plugins are third-party: describe, never copy. BetterModel (MIT) is the only rig engine in the lane.
17. **Bedrock**: Java packs are not auto-converted; glyph fonts show raw codepoints; Geyser custom blocks are "not very stable" (V-s BB); Cyrus only detects Geyser/Floodgate.
18. **Version gaps in Cyrus sheets**: no 1.21.5-1.21.7, 1.21.9, 1.21.10 jars, so any API introduced there (TooltipDisplay 1.21.5, Mannequin 1.21.9, Dialog 1.21.6/7) is only checkable at the four supported versions.
